+class EventSubmissionsController < ApplicationController
+     before_action :require_completed_profile
+
+  def new
+       @submission = EventSubmission.new
+  end
+
+  def create
+       @submission = current_member.event_submissions.build(submission_params)
+
+       if @submission.save
+            redirect_to root_path, notice: "Submission sent. It shows as pending until an officer reviews it."
+       else
+            flash.now[:alert] = "Please fill in all required fields and fix the errors below."
+         render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
+       end
+     rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
+          @submission.errors.add(:base, "You already submitted this event.")
+       flash.now[:alert] = "Your submission could not be sent."
+       render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
+     rescue StandardError => e
+          Rails.logger.error("Event submission failed: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
+       @submission ||= EventSubmission.new
+       flash.now[:alert] = "Your submission could not be sent, try again or contact an officer."
+       render :new, status: :internal_server_error
+  end
+
+  private
+
+       def submission_params
+            params.require(:event_submission).permit(:name, :event_date, :requirement_id, :description)
+       end
+end

+class SubmissionReviewsController < ApplicationController
+     before_action :require_completed_profile
+  before_action :require_admin
+
+  def index
+       @submissions = EventSubmission.pending.includes(:member, :requirement).order(:created_at)
+  end
+
+  def approve
+       submission = EventSubmission.find(params[:id])
+       points = Integer(params[:points].to_s, exception: false)
+
+       if points.nil? || points <= 0
+            return redirect_to submission_reviews_path, alert: "Enter a whole number of points greater than 0."
+       end
+
+       submission.approve!(reviewer: current_member, points: points)
+       redirect_to submission_reviews_path,
+         notice: "Approved. #{points} #{submission.requirement.name} point(s) added for #{submission.member.first_name}."
+     rescue EventSubmission::AlreadyReviewed
+          redirect_to submission_reviews_path, alert: "That request was already reviewed."
+     rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
+          redirect_to submission_reviews_path, alert: "Request not found."
+     rescue StandardError => e
+          Rails.logger.error("Submission approval failed: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
+       redirect_to submission_reviews_path,
+         alert: "Approval could not be saved. The request is still pending and no points were added."
+  end
+
+  def deny
+       submission = EventSubmission.find(params[:id])
+       reason = params[:reason].to_s.strip
+
+       return redirect_to submission_reviews_path, alert: "Enter a reason for denying." if reason.blank?

+          redirect_to submission_reviews_path, alert: "That request was already reviewed."

+       redirect_to submission_reviews_path, alert: "The denial could not be saved. The request is still pending."
+  end
+end

+class EventSubmission < ApplicationRecord
+     class AlreadyReviewed < StandardError; end
+
+  belongs_to :member
+  belongs_to :requirement
+  belongs_to :reviewed_by, class_name: "Member", optional: true
+  belongs_to :point, optional: true
+
+  enum :status, { pending: "pending", approved: "approved", denied: "denied" }, default: "pending"
+
+  before_validation { self.name = name&.strip }
+
+  validates :name, presence: { message: "is required" }
+  validates :description, presence: { message: "is required (describe the event or add proof)" }
+  validates :event_date, presence: { message: "is required and must be a valid date" }
+  validates :name, uniqueness: { scope: %i[member_id event_date], case_sensitive: false,
+                                 message: "was already submitted by you for that date" }
+  validates :denial_reason, presence: true, if: :denied?
+  validate :event_date_not_in_future
+  validate :requirement_is_active, on: :create
+
+  def approve!(reviewer:, points:)
+       with_lock do
+            raise AlreadyReviewed unless pending?
+
+         award = member.point_entries.create!(
+           requirement: requirement, point_amount: points,
+           awarded_date: Date.current, note: "Approved submission: #{name}"
+         )
+         update!(status: :approved, reviewed_by: reviewer, reviewed_at: Time.current, point: award)
+       end
+  end
+
+  def deny!(reviewer:, reason:)
+       with_lock do
+            raise AlreadyReviewed unless pending?
+
+         update!(status: :denied, reviewed_by: reviewer, reviewed_at: Time.current, denial_reason: reason)
+       end
+  end
+
+  private
+
+       def event_date_not_in_future
+            errors.add(:event_date, "can't be in the future") if event_date.present? && event_date > Date.current
+       end
+
+  def requirement_is_active
+       errors.add(:requirement, "is not available") if requirement && !requirement.is_active
+  end
+end

+require "rails_helper"
+
+RSpec.describe EventSubmission, type: :model do
+     let(:reviewer) { create(:member, :admin, :profile_completed) }
+
+  it "is valid from the factory and starts pending" do
+       submission = build(:event_submission)
+    expect(submission).to be_valid
+    expect(submission).to be_pending
+  end
+
+  it "requires a name, a date and a description" do
+       submission = build(:event_submission, name: "", event_date: nil, description: "")
+    expect(submission).not_to be_valid
+    expect(submission.errors.attribute_names).to include(:name, :event_date, :description)
+  end
+
+  it "rejects a future date" do
+       expect(build(:event_submission, event_date: Date.current + 1)).not_to be_valid
+  end
+
+  it "rejects a duplicate for the same member, name (any case) and date" do
+       first = create(:event_submission, name: "Habitat build day")
+    dup = build(:event_submission, member: first.member, requirement: first.requirement,
+                                   name: "habitat BUILD day", event_date: first.event_date)
+    expect(dup).not_to be_valid
+  end
+
+  it "allows the same name on a different date" do
+       first = create(:event_submission)
+    other = build(:event_submission, member: first.member, requirement: first.requirement,
+                                     name: first.name, event_date: first.event_date - 1)
+    expect(other).to be_valid
+  end
+
+  describe "#approve!" do
+       it "adds a point of the right type, links it, and marks the request approved" do
+            submission = create(:event_submission)
+
+         submission.approve!(reviewer: reviewer, points: 2)
+
+         expect(submission.reload).to be_approved
+         expect(submission.reviewed_by).to eq(reviewer)
+         expect(submission.point.point_amount).to eq(2)
+         expect(submission.point.requirement).to eq(submission.requirement)
+         expect(submission.member.total_points).to eq(2)
+       end
+
+    it "cannot be approved twice or award twice" do
+         submission = create(:event_submission)
+      submission.approve!(reviewer: reviewer, points: 1)
+
+      expect { submission.approve!(reviewer: reviewer, points: 1) }
+        .to raise_error(EventSubmission::AlreadyReviewed)
+      expect(submission.member.total_points).to eq(1)
+    end
+
+    it "stays pending and adds no points when saving fails" do
+         submission = create(:event_submission)
+      allow(submission).to receive(:update!).and_raise(ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid)
+
+      expect { submission.approve!(reviewer: reviewer, points: 1) }
+        .to raise_error(ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid)
+
+      expect(submission.reload).to be_pending
+      expect(Point.where(member: submission.member).count).to eq(0)
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "#deny!" do
+       it "records the reason and adds no points" do
+            submission = create(:event_submission)
+
+         submission.deny!(reviewer: reviewer, reason: "No proof attached")
+
+         expect(submission.reload).to be_denied
+         expect(submission.denial_reason).to eq("No proof attached")
+         expect(submission.member.total_points).to eq(0)
+       end
+
+    it "requires a reason and stays pending without one" do
+         submission = create(:event_submission)
+      expect { submission.deny!(reviewer: reviewer, reason: "") }
+        .to raise_error(ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid)
+      expect(submission.reload).to be_pending
+    end
+  end
+end
